name: fable-agentic-whatsapp
description: Fully agentic WhatsApp client and AI supervisor powered by Gemini, Baileys browserless transport, and Model Context Protocol

scripts.prepare: if [ -z "$CI" ] && [ -e .git ] && [ -x node_modules/.bin/lefthook ]; then bun run hooks:install; fi
scripts.lint:ts: oxlint --disable-nested-config -c .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --deny-warnings src ui/src ui/tests ui/vite.config.ts scripts tests patch-baileys.mjs commitlint.config.mjs
scripts.lint:python: uvx --from ruff==0.17.4 ruff check workers/media-python && uvx --from ruff==0.17.4 ruff format --check workers/media-python
scripts.lint:infra: buildifier -mode=check -lint=warn -type=build BUCK toolchains/BUCK && hadolint --failure-threshold warning Dockerfile && docker compose config --quiet
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:python && bun run lint:infra
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --disable-nested-config -c .oxlintrc.json --fix src ui/src ui/tests ui/vite.config.ts scripts tests patch-baileys.mjs commitlint.config.mjs && uvx --from ruff==0.17.4 ruff check --fix workers/media-python && uvx --from ruff==0.17.4 ruff format workers/media-python
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:ui
